facts.fact: Sam 整夜未眠：活门塌陷的触感与"尖叫杀猪般"的坠落反复闪回，Avery 和 Max 的所作所为仍让他震惊。
facts.anchor: He could still feel the trap door of the capsule giving way beneath him and hear himself screaming bloody murder.

facts.fact: Sam 自我辩护的核心：自愿进舱没错，但他从没竖大拇指——所以绝不是意外。
facts.anchor: Sam may have gotten in that drop capsule willingly, but he knew he’d never given them a thumbs up.

facts.fact: 爸爸昨晚谈 Nan 时的紧张崩盘像照镜子（Sam 面对 Joker 时一模一样）——由此怀疑"Nan 到底能干出什么"。
facts.anchor: Which made him wonder what Nan might be capable of.

facts.fact: Lily 上桌求和，解释逃跑原因：风暴里听到可怕的声音——"像是 growl"，还说打给 Rebecca 是因为怕他们出事。
facts.anchor: “Ok. I heard something scary during the storm,” Lily said.

facts.fact: Sam 的"脸颊测谎"：Lily 编话时脸颊会涨红——此刻肤色没变，也许她没撒谎，也许只是听错了。
facts.anchor: When she made something up, her cheeks turned bright red.

facts.fact: Lily 坚持证词："我清楚自己听到了什么——某种动物，或求救的人，我不知道。它不属于这里。"
facts.anchor: I know what I heard. Some kind of animal, or person in distress, or I don’t know. It just doesn’t belong here.

facts.fact: 后果落地：三人宵禁晚 8 点，连守两晚否则搬进 Tranquil Cove 与父母同住；Sam 还弄丢了爸爸的手机。
facts.anchor: The cousins now had a curfew and had to be back in their room by 8 p.m.

facts.fact: Sam 在 promenade 瞥见 Avery 和 Max，瞬间闪回"两个月零三周五天前"的 11 月：Joker 坐在他自行车上叫他 loser。
facts.anchor: Suddenly it was two months, three weeks, and five days ago.

facts.fact: 全盘托出：Max 按了活门按钮把 Sam 射下滑梯，Avery Max 没有跟下来——"他们就这么把他甩了"，绝非意外。
更糟的是：Sam 离开 Silverback 时被 head counselor 抓个正着——被骂上"no-ride list"禁滑到假期结束，Lookout 也被上报；他没供出 Avery 和 Max（不 snitch，因为学校告过老师反被报复）。
facts.anchor: “Before I left the Silverback, I was caught by a head counselor. And he was pissed.”

facts.fact: Sam 的决定："我的计划是复仇。"Jordan 撞拳入伙"Count me in, cuz."
